rv.q: In this frothy comedy, that approach feels inappropriate and yields scant rewards.
Yet for a work that celebrates the liberating force of spontaneity, this version doesn't have one scene that feels organic, let alone impromptu.
Savvy director Scott Elliott — so adept with the edgy British comedies of Mike Leigh and the like — seems positively baffled by the material.

cn.t: Critics pan this Neil Simon revival as a labored, misjudged production that fails to capture the play's charm. While Mizrahi's costumes earn praise, the frantic direction and mechanical performances leave the comedy flat.

vs.sum: A beautifully restored theater with a stunning Tiffany-inspired interior. The 2021 renovation transformed restroom facilities from among Broadway's worst to a model for the industry, with modern bathrooms on every public level.

acc.note: Elevator to Mezzanine, Balcony, and lower level restrooms. 7 wheelchair spaces across all levels.
